scenes.label: Product walkthrough • workflow examples
scenes.title: From opportunity to conversation
scenes.caption: A guided product walkthrough. Workflow examples use fictional demo contacts.
scenes.narration: Coffee Chat Copilot turns a job opportunity into a conversation, with your own voice and review before every message.

scenes.label: Real LinkedIn results
scenes.title: Find people on LinkedIn
scenes.caption: Real results page. In the installed extension, import only the visible people you choose to review.
scenes.narration: This is a real LinkedIn people search. In the installed extension, import visible results from the tab beside the panel.

scenes.label: Demo workflow
scenes.title: Import with review
scenes.caption: Workflow example: fictional contacts. This browser preview does not perform a live LinkedIn import.
scenes.narration: The remaining screens use fictional contacts to demonstrate the workflow. This browser preview does not perform a real LinkedIn import.

scenes.label: Demo workflow
scenes.title: Keep context beside each contact
scenes.caption: Review contact details and their source. Email guesses remain unverified until you check them.
scenes.narration: Review each contact and their source context. An email guess is only a guess, and needs your independent confirmation.

scenes.label: Demo workflow
scenes.title: Write your message once
scenes.caption: Save your voice in a template. Fill placeholders using the job and contact context.
scenes.narration: Write your outreach once. The template keeps your wording while placeholders adapt the message to a job and contact.

scenes.label: Demo workflow
scenes.title: Review, then approve
scenes.caption: Edit, regenerate, skip or approve. Approval alone never sends an email.
scenes.narration: Every draft enters your approval queue. Edit, regenerate, skip, or approve it. Approval alone never sends an email.

scenes.label: Google setup controls • authorization not recorded
scenes.title: Connect your own Google account
scenes.caption: Setup controls only. Google authorization is not recorded, and the AI API key stays on your server.
scenes.narration: These are the Google setup controls. Authorization is not recorded here. Live Gmail and Calendar access requires your own consent in Chrome.

scenes.label: Demo workflow • no invitation sent
scenes.title: Choose a confirmed meeting time
scenes.caption: Demo Calendar workflow. Creating a live event sends a real invitation after you choose the time.
scenes.narration: Once a time is agreed, choose it in the meeting form. This is a demo; no real calendar invitation is sent.

scenes.label: Demo workflow
scenes.title: Build your question bank
scenes.caption: Add, edit or skip suggestions. Only approved bank questions are selected for prep briefs.
scenes.narration: Build a question bank by adding, editing, or skipping suggestions. Only approved bank questions are selected for your prep brief.

scenes.label: Demo workflow
scenes.title: Prepare for the conversation
scenes.caption: Review approved questions and contact context. Check the facts before your chat.
scenes.narration: The prep view brings context and approved questions together, so you can spend the conversation listening instead of searching.

scenes.label: Demo workflow
scenes.title: Turn notes into a thoughtful follow-up
scenes.caption: Demo notes become thank-you drafts, with an optional referral paragraph for your review.
scenes.narration: After the chat, save a few notes. Review a thank-you draft and decide whether to include the optional referral paragraph.

scenes.label: Demo workflow
scenes.title: See every next step
scenes.caption: Track drafts, replies and meetings. No real emails or invitations were sent in this recording.
scenes.narration: The activity view keeps next steps together. This walkthrough sent no real emails or invitations. You stay in control.
